reading.requirement: Exact source text hash and evidence offsets must match.

listening.requirement: Official Conversation MP3, current audio hash, alignment and rights checks must pass; no silent directions as evidence.

modalityPolicy.independentExposure: Same source reading and audio share one exposure group; never count either as unseen after the other.

questions.prompt: What idea about the meeting spreads among the employees?
options: It will announce a new holiday schedule.
It concerns budget cuts and possible job losses.
It will train everyone to use new cameras.
answers: It concerns budget cuts and possible job losses.
questions.evidence: That must be what the meeting is about. When there are budget cuts, people lose their jobs.
questions.explanation: Kaveh把budget cuts与会议内容相连，并进一步联想到失业，这是同事之间扩散的说法。它是角色当时的推测，不是会议最后确认的目的。假期安排和相机培训没有成为这条传言的内容。

spokenEvidence.quote: That must be what the meeting is about. When there are budget cuts, people lose their jobs.

questions.prompt: Why does Anna challenge Jonathan’s use of the word “people”?
options: He has named only one person as a source.
He has spoken only to visitors outside the building.
He has confused two different departments.
answers: He has named only one person as a source.
questions.evidence: Mark in Accounting? That's one person. That's not “people.”
questions.explanation: Jonathan说听到“人们”谈预算削减，却只举出会计Mark。Anna指出one person不等于people，质疑的是消息来源数量，不是部门名称或大楼外的访客。不能把多人转述自动当成多个独立来源。

spokenEvidence.quote: Mark in Accounting? That's one person. That's not “people.”

questions.prompt: What does Anna suggest doing instead of continuing the gossip?
options: Sending the rumour to all departments.
Going to the meeting to find out what happens.
answers: Going to the meeting to find out what happens.
questions.evidence: We'll just go to the meeting and see what happens.
questions.explanation: Anna明确说不应该继续闲谈传言，提出到会上看看究竟发生什么。她没有建议群发消息或缺席。这个选择把等待直接信息与继续放大未经确认的说法区分开来。

spokenEvidence.quote: We'll just go to the meeting and see what happens.

questions.prompt: Why does Amelia not want to return to her former work as a detective?
options: She wants to teach high school instead.
questions.evidence: I can't go back to being a detective. Criminals scare me!
questions.explanation: Amelia直接用Criminals scare me说明不想回去当侦探的原因。害怕高中生的是Kaveh谈到教师旧职时说的话；videographer是她现在被称赞的工作，不能与害怕的对象混淆。

spokenEvidence.quote: I can't go back to being a detective. Criminals scare me!

questions.prompt: What does Kaveh advise Penelope to do?
questions.evidence: Update your résumé. I’ve already updated mine.
questions.explanation: Kaveh让Penelope更新résumé，并补充自己已经更新过了。命令句主语虽省略，接收建议的人仍是Penelope。更长假期或主持会议都不是这句建议；这也不证明她真的要失业。

spokenEvidence.quote: Update your résumé. I’ve already updated mine.

questions.prompt: What purpose does Ms. Weaver finally give for the meeting?
options: To announce that everyone will be fired.
To cancel all reporting work immediately.
To praise the team’s work and give new assignments.
answers: To praise the team’s work and give new assignments.
questions.evidence: The reason for this meeting is to tell you what a good job you’ve been doing and give out new assignments.
questions.explanation: 老板用The reason for this meeting is明确给出真实目的：表扬团队，并分配新任务。她同时否认要解雇在场员工。预算削减确实被提到，但不能把先前的传言当成这次会议的目的。

spokenEvidence.quote: The reason for this meeting is to tell you what a good job you’ve been doing and give out new assignments.
